<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: Use the </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Table of Contents</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> present at the bottom of the channel, or in the pinned comments, to quickly navigate through this channel and find the information you are looking for.</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Some general notes:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The game runs on an internal tick system: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1t (tick) = 0.6s (seconds)</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The minimum time between abilities is called the global cooldown: </nowiki><strong><nowiki>1 gcd = 3t = 1.8s</nowiki></strong><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Auto attacks will only give adrenaline if they hit (splash = no adrenaline gain).</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Debuff spells like Vuln </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1" alt="Vuln" title="Vuln" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Enfeeble </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727986409734145.png?v=1" alt="Enfeeble" title="Enfeeble" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Smoke Cloud </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090641879050.png?v=1" alt="smokecloud" title="smokecloud" kind="icon" /><nowiki> do not give adrenaline.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Some useful sheets and resources are given below.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>To calculate your ability hit damage in detail, </nowiki>[https://tools.runescape.wiki/rs-rot/melee <nowiki>click here</nowiki>]<nowiki>.
This is affected by factors such as your gear and other boosts.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Ability Hit Timings</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>To see detailed breakdowns on ability hit timings, </nowiki>[https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rK7u17JN6I-vf3dKBKg6tm9IPWje9EWSe_r8KPdsxoc/edit?usp=sharing <nowiki>click here</nowiki>]<nowiki>.
This refers to when hitsplats appear on your target.
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Auto-attack Adren Gain</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>To see adrenaline gained with different auto attacks, </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Invigorating <nowiki>click here</nowiki>]<nowiki>.
